m1_content = '''"""Tests for milestone m1: Add .skip, .invalidate, .invalidate_all to memoize wrapper."""


def test_memoize_wrapper_exposes_skip_and_memory():
    """The decorated function exposes .skip (SkipMemoization) and .memory."""
    from funcy import memoize, SkipMemoization

    @memoize
    def f(x):
        return x * 2

    result = f(3)
    assert result == 6
    assert isinstance(f.memory, dict)
    assert (3,) in f.memory
    assert f.memory[(3,)] == 6
    # .skip must be the SkipMemoization exception class
    assert hasattr(f, "skip")
    assert f.skip is SkipMemoization


def test_memoize_invalidate_removes_single_key():
    """Calling invalidate(*args, **kwargs) removes the corresponding key from memory."""
    from funcy import memoize

    @memoize
    def f(x):
        return x * 2

    f(3)
    assert (3,) in f.memory
    f.invalidate(3)
    assert (3,) not in f.memory


def test_memoize_invalidate_all_clears_everything():
    """Calling invalidate_all() clears all cached results."""
    from funcy import memoize

    @memoize
    def f(x):
        return x * 2

    f(1)
    f(2)
    f(3)
    assert len(f.memory) >= 3
    f.invalidate_all()
    assert len(f.memory) == 0
'''

m2_content = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: Add .memory and .skip to cache wrapper, unified with memoize."""


def test_cache_wrapper_exposes_memory_and_skip():
    """The decorated function exposes .memory (live cache dict) and .skip (same as memoize)."""
    from funcy import cache, memoize, SkipMemoization

    @cache(30)
    def cf(x):
        return x * 2

    @memoize
    def mf(x):
        return x * 2

    cf(5)
    mf(5)

    # cache must have .memory with correct structure
    assert hasattr(cf, "memory")
    assert isinstance(cf.memory, dict)
    assert (5,) in cf.memory
    val = cf.memory[(5,)]
    assert isinstance(val, tuple)
    assert len(val) == 2
    assert val[0] == 10

    # cache .skip must be the same object as memoize .skip (unified interface)
    assert hasattr(cf, "skip")
    assert hasattr(mf, "skip")
    assert cf.skip is mf.skip
    assert cf.skip is SkipMemoization


def test_cache_invalidate_still_works_with_new_interface():
    """Existing invalidate functionality still works alongside new attributes."""
    from funcy import cache

    @cache(30)
    def f(x):
        return x * 2

    f(5)
    assert (5,) in f.memory
    f.invalidate(5)
    assert (5,) not in f.memory


def test_cache_invalidate_all_still_works_with_new_interface():
    """Existing invalidate_all functionality still works alongside new attributes."""
    from funcy import cache

    @cache(30)
    def f(x):
        return x * 2

    f(1)
    f(2)
    assert len(f.memory) >= 2
    f.invalidate_all()
    assert len(f.memory) == 0
